groups.rationale: Run d0311878 showed the recorder organic pressure loop never filled the 57 MB archive, so its exhausted-backing, storage-refusal and saturation checks were never evaluated; 17-reference records that the ENOSPC path now evaluates them against its confirmed zero-free backing and refused write, and that archive quota refusal remains unexercised. No native evidence is claimed.

Machine header redesign merged onto current trunk: bordered summary with name, state and operating-system label (Compute.Views projects only the image display name as image_name), inline machine ID with Copy, connect box platform sub-heading; OS label in Machines list, Overview preview and Settings Resources. Chapter 08 documents the header and projection boundary; chapter 19 and scenarios record the LiveView tests and probe check as present, not recorded.
